content:
sara_support: Hi team — AcmeCorp on hosted inference is hitting a recurring 504 spike starting ~2026-03-17T14:02Z. Customer sees streaming requests time out after ~30s, SDK is retrying and generating lots of duplicate calls. They attached SDK logs and a few x-request-id values. Priority: high (trial customer, billing & churn risk).
sara_support: Error sample from customer: `HTTP 504 (Gateway Timeout)` and client shows `Upstream Read Timeout` in their logs.
linda_cs: Customer is worried about billing — they got charged for retries. Can billing block charges while we investigate? @oliver_billing can you advise?
oliver_billing: We can issue a credit for verified duplicate retries. Need list of request_ids + timestamps. Will pause auto-invoicing for this account pending resolution.

mike_oncall: Thanks. Can someone paste the request IDs? I can correlate in edge logs.
sara_support: Provided IDs: rq_20260317_acme_1: x-req=ab12, rq_..._2: x-req=cd34, rq_..._3: x-req=ef56 (sent via secure thread DM to @mike_oncall).
mike_oncall: Found matching traces — lots of 504s from our US-WEST edge between 14:01:40 and 14:05:20. p95 latency for upstream responses jumps. CPU/memory on serving nodes look fine. Suspect gateway (edge proxy) backlog + HTTP/2 stream stalls.
jake_sre: I see connection queue growth on the edge NLB + increased FIN_WAIT sockets on the proxy. Possible client-herd + slow streaming keepalive interplay.
nina_runtime: Do we have any recent deploys to edge-proxy or routing changes?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Completed deploy 2026-03-17T13:50Z -> service=edge-proxy v2.14.2 by ops-ci.
nina_runtime: That deploy touched HTTP/2 flow control defaults (lower window_size for streams) — rolling back to previous flow defaults might fix stalls.
mike_oncall: Quick mitigation: increasing per-connection stream window and bumping keepalive on the proxy might help. I can hotpatch a config and restart proxy workers on us-west nodes.
sara_support: Meanwhile customer asked for repro steps. They shared a minimal Node SDK snippet that reproduces reliably:```js
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.KEY});
await client.chat.stream({model: 'rwd-alpha', input: longPrompt});
// client retries enabled default: 3 backoffs
```
They say longPrompt ~8-12k tokens and they stream with chunked frames.
nina_runtime: Long sequences + streaming often force backend to keep KV cache open and proxies to hold stream windows open. If proxy flow control is too tight, it can block progress and cause read timeouts.
jake_sre: I'm going to enable a temporary routing rule: route streaming requests to a fallback pool with higher stream timeouts and increase proxy keepalive to 60s. Will deploy to us-west now. ETA ~7m.
mike_oncall: Also please ask customer to set SDK to exponential backoff + jitter and to enable `prefer_short_polling` flag (if available) to reduce concurrent streaming multiplex. If they can reduce concurrency to 2 streams concurrently per host that helps.
linda_cs: I've messaged the customer with the suggested SDK change and asked them to run a sanity test after we flip the route.
mike_oncall: Hotpatch applied to us-west edge proxies — increased stream window + keepalive; routing rule active to fallback serving pool. Monitoring now.
jake_sre: Monitoring shows 504s dropping from ~18/min to ~1/min in the affected window. p95 downstream latency stabilized.
oliver_billing: Thanks — collect the duplicated request IDs and times and send to me. I'll prepare a credit for the customer and mark this ticket urgent.
sara_support: Customer reran their test at 14:15Z and reports success — no timeouts, streaming completed. They're still concerned about reliability for production traffic.
nina_runtime: Follow-up action items: 1) Revert/adjust HTTP/2 flow control defaults that landed in 2.14.2 and add canary with synthetic streaming tests. 2) Add autoscaling headroom for fallback pool. 3) Improve SDK doc about streaming backoff guidance. 4) Ops runbook update for temporary routing.
mike_oncall: I'll create the incident and link to postmortem. Tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre, and docs.
sara_support: Customer update sent: we implemented a temporary routing fix, recommend SDK backoff and we'll follow up with a permanent config change and credit. They appreciated the quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
